main_text.l: ubi juramento est opus aliis uti formulis,
& ubi non est opus oportet omnino non
quillitati ferio consultum cupit, ab ejus-
quod iis omnibus non ægre perfuasum
fore existimo, qui earum aut originem
solem, Ignem, & alias creaturas quas pro
diis habuerunt, velut per numina jura-
estatis divinæ apud populum Dei; quæ
oris paulatim abiit in eam superstitio-
snem, aucta præsertim ex prava consuet-
fallent per obvia quævis jurare, quàm ἢ τὸν ποιητὴν καὶ
πατέρα τῶν ὅλων ἀνα-[?]χαλεῖν[?], ut loquitur Philo, ad rerum
um plerosque ritus & mores ex Hebræorum

page.notes: Left edge of the scan cuts off the first letter or two of many lines (for example "Originem", "Ægyptiorum", "fallent", "ferre"). Words marked [?] are read from the visible letters. The reading "superstitiosnem" is a probable printing error for "superstitionem"; it is left as printed in the text. The Greek is set in a line that is partly obscured, so its letters are uncertain. The dashed rule under the last line is a decorative line, not text.
